outputs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: clean cinematic nature plate, widescreen 16:9
Primary request: Cool moonlight macro photograph of a real spider mid-stride over dew-covered moss.
Scene/backdrop: Forest-floor moss ridge at night, seen from a very low macro viewpoint; true black background and negative space beyond the moss.
Subject: One anatomically correct spider, left of centre, moving toward the right; exactly eight clearly coherent legs and two main body parts; animal tack-sharp.
Style/medium: Extremely detailed photorealistic natural-history macro photography, restrained and clean.
Composition/framing: Same direct-comparison composition: low macro eye level, moss ridge running across the lower frame, spider left-of-centre in mid-stride, generous empty room on the right. At least 40% of the entire image must be near-black negative space.
Lighting/mood: A single cold blue-white light from above-left. Fine spider hairs rim-lit silver. Moss deep blue-green. Dew rendered as sparse bright cold points. No warm or brown cast.
Color palette: True black, cold blue-white, silver, deep blue-green.
Constraints: 16:9 landscape; one spider only; anatomically correct eight legs and two body parts; spider sharp; natural moss remains in frame; clean plate.
Avoid: warm light, amber, brown-dominant palette, busy background, extra or fused legs, malformed anatomy, text, letters, numbers, HUD, interface, graphics, lines, borders, watermark.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: clean cinematic nature plate, widescreen 16:9
Primary request: Bioluminescent night macro photograph of a real spider mid-stride over moss.
Scene/backdrop: Forest-floor moss ridge at night, seen from a very low macro viewpoint; the only illumination comes from small glowing fungi and a few glow-worm points embedded naturally in the moss; true black beyond.
Subject: One anatomically correct spider, left of centre, moving toward the right; exactly eight clearly coherent legs and two main body parts; mostly a dark silhouette, animal edges and leg joints tack-sharp.
Style/medium: Extremely detailed photorealistic natural-history macro photography, mysterious but biologically grounded.
Composition/framing: Same direct-comparison composition: low macro eye level, moss ridge running across the lower frame, spider left-of-centre in mid-stride, generous empty room on the right. At least 40% of the entire image must be near-black negative space.
Lighting/mood: No moonlight, no lamp, no ambient fill. Only teal-green bioluminescence from fungi and a few glow-worm points. Cyan rim light outlines the spider and selectively catches its legs.
Color palette: True black, teal, cyan, bioluminescent green; no warm tones.
Constraints: 16:9 landscape; one spider only; anatomically correct eight legs and two body parts; spider silhouette and edges sharp; natural moss remains in frame; clean plate.
Avoid: blue studio light, warm light, amber, brown-dominant palette, excessive glowing objects, fantasy neon overload, busy background, extra or fused legs, malformed anatomy, text, letters, numbers, HUD, interface, graphics, lines, borders, watermark.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: clean cinematic nature plate, widescreen 16:9
Primary request: Iridescent jumping spider nature macro in which the animal's own colour carries the image.
Scene/backdrop: Muted, very dark forest-floor moss ridge at night, seen from a very low macro viewpoint; true black background and clean negative space.
Subject: One anatomically correct peacock spider or similar iridescent jumping spider, left of centre, mid-stride toward the right; exactly eight clearly coherent legs and two main body parts; animal tack-sharp. Its natural blue, red, and iridescent scales provide the saturated colour.
Style/medium: Extremely detailed photorealistic natural-history macro photography, fine scales and hairs catching light, restrained and clean.
Composition/framing: Same direct-comparison composition: low macro eye level, moss ridge running across the lower frame, spider left-of-centre in mid-stride, generous empty room on the right. At least 40% of the entire image must be near-black negative space.
Lighting/mood: One cool soft light, subtle and directional; no colored environmental light. The spider's own blue, red, and iridescent scales glow visually against the darkness; moss stays muted and dark.
Color palette: True black and muted deep moss green, with saturated natural blue, red, cyan-violet iridescence only on the animal.
Constraints: 16:9 landscape; one spider only; anatomically correct eight legs and two body parts; spider sharp; natural moss remains in frame; clean plate; colour belongs to the animal.
Avoid: colorful background, dyed moss, warm or brown cast, oversaturated fantasy creature, busy background, extra or fused legs, malformed anatomy, text, letters, numbers, HUD, interface, graphics, lines, borders, watermark.
